Here's how to publish your site in Gamma:

To publish all changes:

  1. Click the Publish button at the top of your site
  2. This will make your changes live across all pages and settings

To publish a single page:

  1. Open the Pages panel
  2. Click the three-dot menu (…) beside the page
  3. Select Publish This Page

Before publishing, you can preview:

  1. Click the Publish dropdown in the top-right corner
  2. Select Preview to see how your site looks on desktop, tablet, or mobile

If you're seeing an error message like "Error publishing. Publishing is not enabled for this page. Please contact support," this requires examination by a human agent. You can request to speak with a human agent in this conversation if that's the case.

To export your presentation to PowerPoint or Google Slides:

For PowerPoint:

  1. Click Share at the top right, then select Export
  2. Choose PowerPoint (PPTX) format
  3. Your file will download automatically and you'll receive an email copy

For Google Slides:

Export as PowerPoint first, then upload the PPTX file to Google Slides

If export fails, try:

  • Check your internet connection
  • Split very long presentations into smaller sections
  • Compress large images that might be causing issues

The exported content will match how it appears in Present Mode, not Edit Mode

conversation_parts.body:
The charge of $96 instead of $8 may be due to per-member billing—if your workspace included multiple members, you would be billed for each one, which can increase the total charge significantly. To review your charges and manage your subscription, go to Settings & members in the left panel, then open the Billing tab and select Manage subscription. Here, you can view your invoices, update payment methods, and cancel your subscription.

Refunds are only available within the first 7 days of subscribing, and only after contacting support. Since refund processing and removal of credit card details require human assistance, your request will need to be handled by a human agent.

To cancel your subscription, use the Cancel subscription option in the Billing tab. After cancellation, your subscription remains active until the end of the current billing cycle, and no further charges will occur unless you resubscribe. Removing your credit card details also requires human support intervention.

For your refund and card removal requests, please ask to speak with a human agent so they can assist you directly.

conversation_parts.body:
To format a photo to fit properly in Gamma, you have several options depending on your image type:

For standard images:

  • Click and drag the corners to resize proportionally
  • Use the Crop tool: click the image, select Crop from the toolbar, adjust the selection, and click Apply

For accent images (part of card layouts):

  • Switch between Fit Mode (keeps entire image visible) and Fill Mode (expands to cover area, cropping edges) in the image menu
  • Adjust the focus point by clicking "Change focus point" and dragging the circle to reposition what's visible
  • Manually adjust width by clicking and dragging the edge

For images in smart layouts:

  • Select the image and use the layout menu to adjust size and position
  • Use the focus point tool to reposition the image within the layout

You can also resize any image by clicking and dragging its borders after insertion.

To add footnotes that appear at the bottom of your card:

  1. Highlight the text where you want to add a footnote
  2. Click "Add Footnote" from the text formatting menu that appears
  3. A footnote will appear at the bottom of the card where you can enter your reference

The footnote content is housed within the footnote number - click on the footnote number to view or edit the content.

For superscripts (which you can use for custom footnotes), we support them within math blocks using the ^ symbol. For example, type x^2 for superscripts. However, this is specifically for mathematical notation rather than general text formatting.

Our built-in footnote feature automatically handles the formatting and placement at the bottom of cards, which might be more efficient than creating custom superscript footnotes.

conversation_parts.body:
When presentations have lengthy edit histories causing duplication prompts, try copying the content manually instead of using the standard duplicate function.

Here's how to recreate your presentation:

  1. Open the Pages Panel - Click the Pages icon in the top-left of your presentation
  2. Select All Content - Use Cmd + A (Mac) or Ctrl + A (Windows) to select all cards on the current page, then right-click and select Copy or use Cmd + C / Ctrl + C
  3. Create Fresh Presentation - Go to your dashboard, click Create New, choose Presentation, then paste the copied cards using Cmd + V / Ctrl + V
  4. Repeat for Each Page - If your presentation has multiple pages, repeat this process for each page

This method bypasses the edit history issue by creating entirely new content rather than duplicating the problematic file structure.

    • Paste - AI formats existing text you copy/paste
    • Import - AI converts uploaded files into Gamma format

  • Plain Import - Brings in text exactly as-is
  • Import with AI - Restyls and transforms content during import

Atualmente, você pode criar conteúdos em Gamma a partir de prompts usando a função de geração de conteúdo com IA. Basta clicar no ícone de “faísca” em um card, escolher gerar novo conteúdo e inserir seu prompt para que a IA crie textos ou sugestões automaticamente.

I see you're encountering an "Unexpected content type" error. Let's try some troubleshooting steps to resolve this:

First, try the basic fixes:

  • Refresh the page (as suggested in your error message)
  • Clear your browser cache and cookies - corrupted cache files can interfere with Gamma loading

If that doesn't work:

  • Try an incognito window or different browser without extensions - extensions may cause compatibility issues
  • Check your antivirus software - some programs mistakenly block Gamma and may need an exception added
  • Test your firewall - temporarily disable it or try connecting from a different network

Still having issues?

Wait a few minutes and retry - temporary server issues might resolve themselves

Keep note of your Error ID (f4fa962d1de14c4c8555306cf31adb83) as this unique identifier can help with further troubleshooting if needed

conversation_parts.body:
It can take several hours for data to appear in Google Analytics after setting up Google Tag Manager. Since it's been almost 24 hours, here are a few things to check:

Verify your setup:

  • Make sure your GTM ID (starts with GTM-XXXX) is correctly added to your Gamma site settings
  • Confirm your GTM tag is configured to fire on "All Pages"
  • Check that you've published both your GTM container and your Gamma site

Common issues:

  • The GTM ID in Gamma should be the container ID (GTM-XXXX), not your Google Analytics Measurement ID (G-XXXXXXX)
  • Ensure your Google Analytics tag inside GTM is properly configured with the correct Measurement ID

If everything appears correct but you're still not seeing data after 24+ hours, there may be a configuration issue that needs closer examination.

"Content Security Policy of your site blocks the use of 'eval' in JavaScript"
This is your problem! Gamma has a Content Security Policy (CSP) that's blocking GTM from running properly. GTM needs to use certain JavaScript features that Gamma's security settings are blocking.
This is a Gamma configuration issue, not something you can fix in GTM.
Here's what you need to do:

Contact Gamma support and tell them: "My site's Content Security Policy is blocking Google Tag Manager from loading. I need to allow 'unsafe-eval' in the CSP for GTM to work."
Alternative: Check if Gamma has any CSP or security settings you can adjust. Look for settings related to:

Content Security Policy
JavaScript permissions
Third-party scripts


Workaround: Ask Gamma if they have a native Google Analytics 4 integration instead of using GTM. This would bypass the CSP issue entirely.

Unfortunately, this isn't something you can fix on your end - Gamma needs to either adjust their CSP settings to allow GTM, or you need to use a different tracking solution that Gamma supports natively.

  2. Попробуйте экспортировать отдельные карточки вместо всей презентации - наведите на карточку, нажмите три точки и выберите загрузку
  3. Проверьте экспорт в другом формате (PDF) для сравнения

Если проблема сохраняется после этих шагов, возможно потребуется дополнительная диагностика.

To manage or cancel your subscription:

Managing Your Subscription:

  1. Go to Settings & members in the left panel
  2. Select the Billing tab
  3. Click Manage subscription in Stripe to view/edit payment methods and invoices

Canceling Your Subscription:

  1. In the Billing tab, select Cancel subscription
  2. Confirm your cancellation within Stripe

Your subscription remains active until the current billing period ends.

Important Notes:

  • Cancel at least 30 days before renewal to avoid the next billing cycle
  • Refunds are only available within 7 days of subscribing and require contacting support
  • You won't automatically receive a refund for canceling

conversation_parts.body:
Email changes aren't natively supported in our app, but there's a workaround to transfer your content to a new email address.

The process involves:

  1. Invite your new email to your current workspace via Settings & Members > Members
  2. Accept the invitation by logging out and signing into the new email (you can use Google or email/password)
  3. Transfer all presentations by sharing each one individually with "Full access" to your new account
  4. Make the new email an admin of the workspace
  5. Remove your old account once everything is transferred

Important notes:

  • You'll need access to both your current and new email addresses during this process
  • If you're on a paid plan, you'll need to contact support first for subscription cancellation and prorated refund
  • Check "Gammas > All" to verify all presentations transferred properly

It sounds like you're experiencing issues when copying content between gammas. Here are some troubleshooting steps that might help:

For Import Issues:

- Try exporting your content as .docx or .pptx before importing

- You can copy and paste directly into Gamma if the importer fails

- Use /split between sections to divide content into separate cards

When Copying Between Gammas:

- Select the cards in the filmstrip, right-click and choose Copy, then paste into your new gamma

- Pasted cards retain their content and formatting but inherit the theme of the new gamma

- You can undo any paste action with Cmd + Z (Mac) or Ctrl + Z (Windows)

If these steps don't resolve the issue with your content getting "stuck," the problem may require closer examination of your specific gamma files.

To remove another user from your workspace, you'll need admin privileges. Here's how:

Remove a Member from Your Workspace:

  1. Click the dropdown in the top-left corner of your dashboard
  2. Select Settings & Members
  3. Go to the Members tab
  4. Find the user you want to remove
  5. Click Remove from workspace next to their role

Important Notes:

  • Only administrators can remove members from a workspace
  • Removing a user means they'll lose access to all shared work in that workspace
  • Their content will remain in the workspace, but they won't be able to access or edit it

If you want to permanently delete an account instead, that's a different process involving Account Settings > Sign in & security > Delete my account

conversation_parts.body: is there difference on subscription if we have 2 admin in an account?

Yes, having 2 admins will double your subscription cost. Our billing is per user, regardless of their role (admin or member).

For example, if you're on a $20/month plan with 2 users (both admins), your total monthly bill will be $40. This applies to all paid plans - Plus, Pro, and Ultra.

The subscription level is tied to the workspace, not individual users, so each workspace gives all members the same subscription benefits. But you're charged for each person who has access.

If you want to reduce costs, you can remove one admin from the workspace through Settings & Members > Members tab.

Hello Wayne,

Upon reviewing your account, I can confirm that on November 4 last year, you initially subscribed to the Plus Annual plan for $96. The following day, on November 5, you upgraded to the Pro Annual plan, which is originally priced at $180. Since you had already paid for the Plus plan, you were only charged the difference of $83.96 at that time.

This year, your subscription renewed at the same Pro Annual rate of $180, which matches the full price of the plan you upgraded to last year.

Please let me know if you have any other questions or need further clarification.

Hi Kael,

Thank you so much for following up. I do remember subscribing but I’m not sure about upgrading the following day. But, my question that comes to mind is, we do have a website we published through Gamma. Do we need the pro annual plan to publish websites? That is the only thing I can think of. But if pro level subscription is not necessary to keep our published website, would it be possible to edit our annual plan?
​

Best wishes,

Wayne

Thank you for following up.

You don’t necessarily need the Pro Annual plan to keep your published website live. All users, including those on the Free or Plus plans, can publish a site using Gamma’s default sub-domain (e.g., your-site.gamma.site). However, the Pro plan is required if you’re using a custom domain (e.g., yourcompany.com) or want access to advanced features such as analytics and branding removal.

If you’re only using the default Gamma sub-domain and don’t need the extra Pro features, you can safely downgrade your plan.

Here’s how to do that:

  1. Log in to your Gamma account.
  2. Click your profile icon in the upper-right corner.
  3. Go to Settings → Billing.
  4. Under Plan, select Manage plan.
  5. Choose a lower plan (e.g., Plus Annual) or cancel your current Pro subscription.

Once you’ve completed the downgrade, please let me know so I can proceed with processing the refund for the price difference.

To fix cards being cut off when exporting to PDF, you need to set a fixed card size in Page Setup.
​

Here's how to ensure consistent A4 formatting:

  1. Open your gamma and click the three-dot menu (…) in the top-right corner
  2. Select Page Setup
  3. In the Card Size dropdown, select a4 instead of "fluid"
  4. This ensures your content fits within A4 dimensions for proper PDF export

Why this happens: By default, cards are "fluid" meaning they automatically resize based on content, which can create inconsistent heights that don't fit standard page sizes. Setting a fixed A4 size prevents cards from extending beyond printable boundaries.

Once you apply the A4 setting, all cards will maintain consistent dimensions suitable for PDF export without cutting off content.

Hi Miranda,

To connect your custom domain (www.brookvillellc.com) to your Gamma website, follow these steps:

  1. Open your Gamma site (the one you want to connect the domain to).
  2. Click the three-dot menu (…​) in the top-right corner and select Site Settings.
  3. Go to the Domains section and click Add Domain.
  4. Enter your custom domain (e.g., www.brookvillellc.com).
  5. Choose either Automatic Setup (recommended) or Manual DNS Setup:
    • For Automatic Setup, follow the on-screen prompts.
    • For Manual Setup, copy the DNS records provided and add them to your domain registrar's DNS settings.
  6. After domain verification, allow a few hours for your SSL certificate to activate. Temporary security warnings may appear but should resolve once the certificate is issued.
  7. Once connected, click Publish to push your site live to the new domain.

If you encounter issues, double-check your DNS settings and allow up to 24 hours for changes to take effect. If your domain was previously connected to another platform, make sure it's unlinked there before connecting to Gamma.

How can I remove users from my workspace?

conversation_parts.body:
To remove another admin from your workspace:

  1. Access workspace settings - Click the dropdown in the top-left corner of your dashboard and select Settings & members
  2. Go to Members tab - Click the Members tab to view all current workspace members
  3. Remove the admin - Find the admin you want to remove and click Remove from workspace next to their role. Confirm the removal

Important note: Only workspace admins can remove users, including other admins. When you remove them, they'll lose access to all shared work within the workspace, but their content will remain .

If you can't remove another admin because the option is deactivated, this is likely because only workspace admins can remove users, including other admins.

Here are the most common reasons why the remove option might be deactivated:

• Admin permissions required - You need admin privileges to add or remove users. If you're not an admin, ask someone who is, or request to be made an admin.

• Role restrictions - Only users with Admin permissions can update roles and remove members. If you don't see the option, check your current role.

To verify your admin status, go to Settings & members > Members tab and check your role in the list. If you're listed as an admin but still can't remove the other admin, there may be workspace-specific restrictions in place.

Sie können die Schriftgröße in Gamma auf zwei Arten anpassen:

Direkte Textformatierung:

  1. Markieren Sie den Text, den Sie formatieren möchten
  2. Ein Formatierungsmenü erscheint automatisch darüber
  3. Wählen Sie die gewünschte Schriftgröße aus dem Menü oder tippen Sie / und wählen eine Größe

Über ein benutzerdefiniertes Theme:

  1. Gehen Sie zu Themes und klicken auf das Drei-Punkte-Menü (…) neben einem Theme
  2. Wählen Sie Theme anpassen
  3. Unter Schriftarten können Sie die Typografie anpassen, einschließlich Schriftgrößen
  4. Speichern Sie Ihr angepasstes Theme

Das benutzerdefinierte Theme ist besonders nützlich, da es die Schriftgröße für alle Ihre Präsentationen einheitlich festlegt und somit auch beim Export konsistent bleibt.

conversation_parts.body:
Gamma Plus does not automatically make your Gammas discoverable by search engines. Only Pro and Ultra plans allow you to enable search engine indexing, and this must be toggled on manually in the sharing settings—it's not automatic with a Plus subscription. If your Gammas are currently public or discoverable, you can make them private again by:

  1. Opening your Gamma and clicking the Share button at the top right.
  2. In the sharing settings, set access to No access or restrict it to specific people or workspace members.
  3. If your Gamma is a site, you can also disable it entirely by going to the three-dot menu (… ) > Site Settings and toggling Site Enabled off. This will remove public access immediately, but your content will remain editable.

These steps will ensure your Gammas are private and not accessible to search engines or the public.

conversation_parts.body: Hello! How can I assist you today?
i can not able to pulish my site

Here's how to publish your site in Gamma:

To publish all changes:

  1. Click the Publish button at the top of your site
  2. This will make your changes live across all pages and settings

To publish a single page:

  1. Open the Pages panel
  2. Click the three-dot menu (…) beside the page
  3. Select Publish This Page

Before publishing, you can preview:

  1. Click the Publish dropdown in the top-right corner
  2. Select Preview to see how your site looks on desktop, tablet, or mobile

If you're seeing an error message like "Error publishing. Publishing is not enabled for this page. Please contact support," this requires examination by a human agent. You can request to speak with a human agent in this conversation if that's the case.

What specific issue are you encountering when trying to publish?

Teams in Gamma are managed through workspaces. To access team features:

For Teams Plan:

  • Visit our pricing page to set up a Teams plan (minimum 2 seats)

To manage your team:

  1. Click the dropdown in the upper-left corner of your dashboard
  2. Select Settings & members
  3. Navigate to the Members tab

From there you can:

  • Add team members by entering email addresses
  • Copy invite links to share with teammates
  • Manage user roles and permissions

! Thanks for sharing the screenshot! This kind of issue usually happens when the Gamma you’re working on becomes too large or contains too many cards or media files, which can cause the page to slow down or freeze.

Please try the following steps:

  1. Clear your browser’s cache and restart it.
  2. Try opening the Gamma in an incognito window or another browser (Chrome is recommended).
  3. If it still freezes, try splitting your content into smaller Gammas, this usually helps with large presentations.
